description.p: GitTrellis is a native Git client for Linux. It lets you review working tree changes, stage and unstage files or individual hunks, inspect diffs side by side, browse the commit graph, manage branches, tags, stashes and remotes, resolve merge conflicts, and fetch, pull and push — without leaving the desktop.

GitTrellis uses your existing Git configuration: SSH agent, credential helpers, commit signing and known hosts all work as they do on the command line. Nothing is re-implemented and no credentials are stored by the application itself.

First alpha release of GitTrellis (formerly Stratum). Adds editable keyboard shortcuts, direct fetch and one-click push/pull, automatic refresh, file-name search in history, a native authentication dialog with optional SSH-agent loading, and many fixes including unstaging in repositories without commits.
First release: changes view with hunk staging, diff viewer, commit graph, branches, remotes, tags, stashes, conflict resolution, clone, init and settings.
